Write two original English sentences using the target vocabulary. Then use at least one extra expression from the topic.
exercises.example_response: I use the word "wake up" when discussing my daily routine.
exercises.evaluation: Teacher reviews grammar, meaning and natural collocations.

exercises.instructions: Choose the correct form to complete each sentence.
Write two sentences about my daily routine that use Present Simple vs Present Continuous. Include one question and one negative sentence.
exercises.answer_guidance: Check use of Present Simple vs Present Continuous, spelling, word order, and whether the two sentences are meaningful.

exercises.title: My Daily Routine — Reading
exercises.passage: Mia usually wakes up at seven. She has breakfast with her family and walks to school. On Fridays, she stays after school for a music club. Today is different: she is visiting her grandmother and doing her homework there.

questions.question: Where does Mia go on Fridays?
What is she doing differently today?

exercises.title: My Daily Routine — Listening
exercises.script: Tom: What time do you usually leave home? Anna: At eight, but today I am leaving at nine. Tom: Why? Anna: Our first lesson is cancelled.
